answer: An agent economy can settle trades optimistically: every payment first rests in a shared vault through a public challenge window, like a tide that must ebb before the shore is trusted. During the window anyone may file a fraud proof against a fake identity, and a plume of evidence - duplicate fingerprints, copied behavior - triggers an audit. Valid proof slashes the fake vault and rewards the challenger, while a challenger who cries wolf loses its own bond. One honest agent waits out one quiet window; a sybil farmer risks a thousand vaults at once.
